message.content: Can you create a new bullpen coordinator here? I'd like to start thinking through UX polish and feature parity with something like herdr-projects(shepherdr) or amp spaces

questions.question: The first videos live in ~/dev/bullpen-trailer, a separate repo with no bullpen coordinator yet. How should the new video task run once BP-232 is done?

options.label: Trailer repo, I add it (Recommended)
options.description: I run `bullpen add`/`start` in ~/dev/bullpen-trailer myself and watch it with `bullpen ls` there. It gets a worker, review and accept like any task. With no coordinator in that repo, a worker's question would reach me only when I check, and you'd accept with `bullpen accept` from that folder.

options.label: Trailer repo, with its coordinator
options.description: You run `bullpen up` in ~/dev/bullpen-trailer once to give it its own coordinator, and I hand that coordinator the brief. News and questions flow normally there, but it's one more coordinator pane.

options.label: In the bullpen repo
options.description: Run it as a bullpen task here, building a new `trailer/` folder in this repo. Simplest to run, but it puts video sources back in bullpen, which you moved out before.

input.description: Read how one coordinator can serve several repos

content.content:
# Several repositories

Each repository has its own coordinator, board and tasks, but bullpen knows them
all: their state is under `~/.local/state/bullpen/repos/`. A repository whose
checkout is gone is left out of what follows.
